alt: 一位穿淡藍長裙的成年女子走過花園，周圍賓客帶著欣賞的神情望向她。
scene_prompt: An original adult woman with a radiant gentle face, graceful posture, dark loosely tied hair and an elegant simple pale blue dress strolls through a garden reception. Several adult guests nearby pause with warm admiring expressions at her striking beauty and poise. Flowers subtly frame her without obscuring her face. Respectful nonsexual depiction, realistic adult proportions, no collapsing buildings or disaster.
